_comment: Which of Wiktionary's English pronunciations this edition wants. Read by lib/translit.py prefers() for lib/getdict.py _ipa; there is no `map` -- the English verb recipe writes the house style itself (n̩ as ən, no stress on one syllable, r-colour), which a character table cannot.
_avoid: Received-Pronunciation, UK, US and Canada are deliberately not avoided: kill's only /ˈkɪl/ is tagged Received-Pronunciation and US, and fight's /faɪt/ is tagged RP while its US-tagged one is the Canadian-raising /fəɪt/. A sound is avoided only when every one of its tags is in this list (fix's only /fɪks/ is tagged Australia, Canada, UK and US), and a `weak form` is skipped while any other is left (do /də/, was /wəz/) -- both lib/getdict.py _ipa's to apply.
